title: Bias of the generator distribution
statement: Let $n,\ell$ be natural numbers with $\ell>0$, and choose an irreducible monic binary modulus of degree $\ell$. If $\varepsilon\in\mathbb R$ satisfies $n/2^\ell\leq\varepsilon$, then the distribution of outputs obtained by choosing the two length-$\ell$ binary seeds uniformly is $\varepsilon$-biased: for every nonzero binary vector $\gamma$ of length $n$, the absolute value of its Fourier coefficient is at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: The implementation has an irreducible monic binary modulus of degree $\ell$
